articles.headline: The players who played no minutes at the World Cup -- who were the unlucky few?
articles.description: The World Cup was a time to remember for most, for a handful of players though, their time at the tournament was merely sitting in the best seats in the house.

articles.headline: Lopes Cabral stunner for Cape Verde voted best World Cup goal
articles.description: Cape Verde made more World Cup history on Monday when Sidny Lopes Cabral won the public vote for goal of the tournament.

articles.headline: Don't be fooled by Klopp's, Zidane's new international jobs: Club soccer is still top of the game
articles.description: Despite the flurry of big-name hires, international jobs remain a route to redemption or a quieter life away from the intensity of an elite club role.

articles.headline: Would the U.S. actually win the World Cup if its best athletes played soccer?
articles.description: Every time the USMNT gets knocked out of a World Cup, the question comes up: What if our best U.S. athletes played soccer? Here's why that flight of fancy would never actually work out.

articles.headline: Argentina's Lionel Scaloni defends players after World Cup, critics are 'people who don't know us'
articles.description: Argentina coach Lionel Scaloni has defended his players and called them "warriors" in the wake of the World Cup final defeat to Spain.

articles.headline: Slavko Vincic retires after refereeing World Cup final
articles.description: World Cup final referee Slavko Vincic has retired just a week on from the tournament's conclusion.
